label: tensor-contraction IC (ic.tensor_contraction_v1, m = 2) against rho.negation and the prime IC baseline on the registered bench-roster prime curves of 10, 12 and 14 bits (counts and L2 wall time)
description: Speed of the toy index calculus of crates/ecdl-tensor-ic (Rust port of the Go ecdltensor prototype): relations found by exact sparse tensor contraction of the whole-point network over m = 2 SHA-256 hashed factor bases. Exponential by construction (no [Ope26] solver); the session measures its cost in S and wall time against the matched rho reference, the prime-curve ic.pipeline baseline and a rho A/A control. The 16-bit roster curve is measured in counts only by tensor-ic-vs-rho-16.json. Protocol: research/ecdl_tensor_ic_speed_20261030/protocol.json.
